dataset.snapshot_note: Committed decision files; archived *.audit-failed.json excluded by suffix (structural (url,pin) supersession dedup).

determinism.runtime_versions: python >= 3.10 (pyproject requires-python); z3-solver==5.0.0 pinned. Literal interpreter versions are NOT embedded: they differ across the CI matrix and would break byte-stable regeneration.

escape_baseline.note: Fixed constant for the shared-gate one-sided z-test; never re-derived from a live window.

eval.flip_rule: bootstrap difference-distribution CI (v1.5 - v1) excludes 0, one-sided IMPROVEMENT only (lo > 0), AUC-only, no OR alternative
eval.k_note: Frozen a priori — no K search anywhere in Phase 0 code paths.
eval.missing_values: median imputation from TRAIN split only

protocol.escape_test: one-sided z-test of window rate vs fixed baseline; null SE = sqrt(b0*(1-b0)/n); fires when p < 0.05
protocol.fire_blocks: #550 Phase 2 scale (shared gate; no low-yield unlock)
protocol.two_windows_rule: n < floor requires two consecutive 7-day windows

split.rule: train-only imputation + K selection; test-half evaluated exactly once (AUC flip metric).
